title: Grilled Beef Skewers with Dutch Seasoning
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish perfect for a summer evening. The combination of beef, Dutch seasoning, and a hint of nuttiness will leave you wanting more.

ingredients.name: Dutch seasoning
ingredients.notes: Available in most supermarkets or online

ingredients.name: Nice (1/2 cup)
ingredients.notes: Peanuts or peanut butter can be used as a substitute

ingredients.name: Nutty (2 tablespoons)
ingredients.notes: Walnut oil or chopped walnuts can be used as a substitute

ingredients.name: Skewers (10-12)
ingredients.notes: Wooden or metal skewers can be used

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Dutch seasoning, nice (peanuts), and nutty (walnut oil).
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the beef cubes onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked through to an internal temperature of 140°F.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
